name: dialog-stack
title: Dialog stack
description: A modal with steps that stack behind each other, built on the native dialog element.

a11y.text: It is a native modal dialog, so focus is trapped. Esc steps back one step, and closes the dialog on the first step. The back arrow does the same step back, and a backdrop click closes. Each step gets next, back and close in its content function.

The dialog is labelled by the title of the current step. The step on top is the only one reachable: earlier steps behind it are inert and aria-hidden. Back (from the second step on) and Close are icon buttons named by backLabel and closeLabel, with aria-hidden icons.
The content is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user, so Motion follows the system setting for the step animation.
